name: Nicolae Ceaușescu
summary: Ceaușescu defended a centrally planned socialist economy, national independence and communist party leadership. His rule became increasingly personalist and repressive, combining a leader cult and cultural control with compulsory pronatalism and severe austerity to repay foreign debt.
